sections.Profile:
The 8 Ball pinball machine, released by Williams in 1966, was designed by Norm Clark and features artwork by Art Stenholm. A billiards-themed electro-mechanical (EM) machine, 8 Ball was notable for introducing the "split bank" concept, allowing players to track which targets had been hit by each player during a two-player game.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Pool (Billiards), Original Theme
